page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with paragraph numbers at the start of some paragraphs and no marginal notes. Below the text, at the right, is the gathering signature.

main_text.p: vultum: qui sanguis miftus lacrymis ad pedes ipforum à fastidiosis vermibus recolligebatur. Ita fuerunt, nempe Bonifacius VIII. mufca aut vespa pungens, Clemens & Ioannes vermes sanguinem excipientes etiam ad miraculum vsque, vt postea Bellarminus narrat. ludicent prudentes & docti, vtra pars verius de Celestino sentiat: Dantes certe vir prudens & magnus sine praeiudicio sententiam tulit eius rei, quam suis oculis viderat. Ridiculum est, indigitari sanctos posse à tam impiis capitibus. Cardinalis Cameracensis, qui post annos amplius 150. vixit ab illo seculo, res auditas à superstitiosis & imperitis hominibus, non à certis visas idoneisque retulit. Certissimus testis Dantes.

9 Art.5. Dantes quidem non parum vituperat, sed ob vitam & mores. ] locus est de Simonia, in quo Pontifices iftos omneis collocauit Dantes cant.19. inferni. Sed ifti mores sunt Antichristo & damnata illa meretrice digni, quos Dantes obiicit, dicens: Et se non sofe, ch'ancor, &c. Profecto iftos pontifices quos Dantes carpit, à pietate aut probitate nemo laudauit historicus. De clero, eadem ratio: quem damnata illa Simonia, ex-auctoratum effecit iamdiu.
10 Ibid. in Domino collocata, nunquam tempefta-te sacrilegi schismatis diffipetur? ] ad haec omnia diu responsum est contr. 3.lib. 2. & contr. 4 lib.2.&3.
II Ibid. Dantes factione Gibellinus ] criminatio falsa: vt ante in cap. 12. nota 5. ostendimus & fal-fum consequens.
II Artic. 6. cur nobis non liceat eidem Danti, quem poëtam, non prophetam fuisse scimus, interdum etiam fidem non habere? ] argumentatio dispar,

page.notes: The left and right margins carry no printed notes. Faint marks at the left edge and a small mark at the right edge are show-through or the neighbouring page and are left out. The paragraph numbers 9, 10 and II sit at the start of their paragraphs in the text and are kept there. Doubtful readings: "factione" (the word in the Ibid. line is hard to read; read as factione), "diffipetur" and "Certissimus" (both read from a slightly blurred scan). The printed "fal-" / "fum" and "ex-" / "auctoratum" line-end hyphens are kept. The printing error "II" for the paragraph number is copied as printed.
